theorems.name: Submission.dorag_tes_gv_split_integral_estimate
theorems.statement: ∀ (X : Type) [MeasurableSpace X] (μ : Measure X) (A B F : Set X) (u g t : X → ℝ) (G : ℝ) (C : ℝ≥0∞), MeasurableSet A → MeasurableSet B → MeasurableSet F → A ⊆ B → 0 ≤ G → IntegrableOn u B μ → ENNReal.ofReal |∫ x in B, u x ∂μ| ≤ C → (∀ᵐ x ∂μ, x ∈ B → |u x| ≤ G) → (∀ᵐ x ∂μ, x ∈ B → x ∉ A → x ∈ F → u x = 0) → (∀ᵐ x ∂μ, x ∈ A → |u x - g x| ≤ G * t x) → ENNReal.ofReal |∫ x in A, g x ∂μ| ≤ ENNReal.ofReal G * (∫⁻ x in B, ENNReal.ofReal (t x) ∂μ + μ (B \ F)) + C
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
